title: Calibrate the judge before tuning against it
statement: Calibrate a judge against people before tuning a generator on its scores, and if calibration fails, repair the judge or its rubric rather than tune against it.
example: An AP evaluation contract lets generation proceed only once every cell reaches at least 85% exact machine-human agreement and zero machine false negatives on its eight hard gates.
detail: An evaluation contract for AP question generation makes calibrating machine judgment against people a step of its own, ahead of the fixed generation sample. It proceeds only if every cell shows at least 85% exact machine-human agreement on whether a record qualifies and zero machine false negatives on the eight hard gates; if calibration fails, the evaluator or rubric is repaired, and the generator is never tuned against a broken judge. The order matters because a generator tuned to a judge's scores takes on whatever the judge gets wrong.
against: The contract was frozen as a design and never run: an AP checkpoint records that no run had been executed for that hand-off (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0170-apush-deliverable-shape-user-pause-checkpoint.qmd`, line 64).

evidence.quote: Proceed only if every cell has: - at least 85% exact machine-human qualification agreement; and - zero machine false negatives on the eight hard gates. If calibration fails, repair the evaluator or rubric. Do not tune the generator against a broken judge.
